questions.promptVi: [Trắc nghiệm] Chọn từ/cụm từ đúng để hoàn thành câu (Anh ấy đã rất mệt bởi vì anh ấy đã chạy bộ suốt.):
questions.question: He was tired because he had been ___.
options: running
run
ran
runs
questions.correctAnswer: running
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc: had been + V-ing (running).

have been
was been
had
